actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Donald Trump is driving major media coverage across multiple fronts, including hosting White House summits with top tech executives on AI regulation, rolling back federal automotive fuel efficiency standards, and imposing new trade restrictions. He is also actively campaigning at midterm rallies in Nebraska and Ohio while navigating Supreme Court rulings regarding his administration's deportation policies.
